narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Angles are always whole numbers, so the gap is fifty one degrees.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Seven gaps of fifty one degrees each make only three hundred fifty seven degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That leaves three degrees uncovered, so the gap cannot be a whole number.
